notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Pitiless Plunderer and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
